tasks.title: Project Setup - React + Tailwind + shadcn/ui
tasks.description: Initialize React project with Vite, install and configure Tailwind CSS, install shadcn/ui components library. Set up project structure with src/components, src/pages, src/hooks, src/lib, src/data folders. Configure path aliases (@/ for src). Install react-router-dom for navigation. Create basic App.tsx with router outlet.

tasks.title: Design System Configuration - Dark Theme
tasks.description: Configure Tailwind theme with dark mode colors: background #141414, sidebar #0d0d0d, accent colors from reference files. Set up shadcn/ui with dark theme. Configure typography scale (font sizes, weights) matching reference HTML. Define CSS variables for consistent theming. Add custom Tailwind utilities for gradient backgrounds, scrollbar styling.

tasks.title: Mock Data Layer
tasks.description: Create mock data files for content: featured hero content, content rows (Continue Watching, Trending Now, By Genre, Top Rated, New Releases), search results, ratings filter data. Include placeholder thumbnail URLs (using placeholder image services), titles, metadata (year, rating, genre, duration), and descriptions. Export as TypeScript constants for type safety.

tasks.title: Sidebar Component - Persistent Navigation
tasks.description: Build persistent 80px sidebar component with fixed positioning. Include navigation items: Home (active), Search, Ratings, Settings. Use shadcn/ui Sidebar or custom implementation matching reference: dark background #0d0d0d, icons with #ccc default / #fff active state, 48px gap between items. Search icon triggers flyout overlay. Position at left, full height, z-index above content.

tasks.title: Layout Wrapper - Main Content Area
tasks.description: Create Layout component that wraps all pages with Sidebar on left and main content area (flex: 1, overflow-x: hidden). Background #141414. Provide slot for page content. Handle responsive behavior - sidebar collapses on mobile or stays fixed. Export as reusable Layout component.

tasks.title: Hero Section Component
tasks.description: Build Hero section component matching reference: min-height 780px, gradient background (to bottom, #666 to #333), hero info panel at bottom-left with padding 40px 48px. Display hero title (64px, font-weight 500), meta list (year, rating, genre, duration - 18px, #ccc, 24px gap), Watch Now button (rgba(255,255,255,0.15) bg, 18px 32px padding, 16px font). Add My List and Rate buttons. Use mock hero data.

tasks.title: Content Row Component - Reusable
tasks.description: Create reusable ContentRow component for horizontal scrolling rows: section title (24px, font-weight 500), horizontal scroll container with gap 16px, padding 0 48px. ContentCard child: thumbnail (aspect-ratio 2:3, rounded 4px), title overlay on hover, metadata. Support different row types (Continue Watching with progress bar, Trending, By Genre, etc.). Use mock content data.

tasks.title: Home Page - Hero + Content Rows Assembly
tasks.description: Assemble Home page using Layout wrapper: Hero section at top, followed by multiple ContentRow components (Continue Watching, Trending Now, Action, Comedy, Drama, Horror, Sci-Fi, Top Rated, New Releases). Vertical spacing between rows. Full page scroll. Connect mock data. Route at '/'.

tasks.title: Search Overlay Component
tasks.description: Build search overlay triggered from sidebar search icon: full-screen overlay (fixed inset-0, bg #141414/rgba(0,0,0,0.9)), large search input centered (transparent bg, no border, 48px font, placeholder 'Search movies, shows...'), recent searches list below, close on Escape or click outside. Flyout from sidebar search icon also works as quick search. State managed via context or props.

tasks.title: Search Results Page
tasks.description: Create Search Results page at '/search': Layout with sidebar, header showing search query and result count, grid of content cards (responsive: 2 col mobile, 4 tablet, 6 desktop), vertical scrolling. Filter tabs: All, Movies, Shows. Sort dropdown: Relevance, Rating, Release Date, A-Z. Use mock search results data. Empty state when no results.

tasks.title: Ratings Filter Page
tasks.description: Build Ratings Filter page at '/ratings': Layout with sidebar. Two-column layout - left sidebar (280px) with filter accordions: Genre (multi-select), Rating Range (slider 0-10), Release Year (range), Duration, Language. Right panel: results grid same as search results. Apply/Reset filters buttons. Sticky filter summary. Use mock ratings filter data.

tasks.title: Routing & Navigation Integration
tasks.description: Wire up react-router-dom routes: '/' -> Home, '/search' -> SearchResults, '/ratings' -> RatingsFilter. Connect Sidebar nav items to routes with active state highlighting. Search flyout/overlay navigates to /search with query param. Ensure browser back/forward works. Add loading states for route transitions.

tasks.title: Responsive Design & Mobile Breakpoints
tasks.description: Implement responsive breakpoints: Mobile (<640px) - sidebar collapses to icons only or drawer, hero height reduced, content rows 2-col grid, search overlay full screen, ratings filter drawer. Tablet (640-1024px) - sidebar 80px, hero 600px, 3-4 col grids. Desktop (>1024px) - full layout per reference. Test touch scrolling for horizontal rows. Adjust font sizes, spacing per breakpoint.

tasks.title: Polish - Animations, Transitions, Accessibility
tasks.description: Add polish: Framer Motion or CSS transitions for sidebar hover, card hover scale (1.02), overlay fade in/out, route transitions. Focus visible states for keyboard nav. ARIA labels on icon buttons. Semantic HTML (nav, main, section, button). Skip to main content link. Color contrast verification. Smooth scroll for anchor links. Loading skeletons for content rows.

tasks.title: Build Verification & Documentation
tasks.description: Run build to verify no TypeScript/ESLint errors. Test all routes manually: Home hero + rows, Search overlay + results page, Ratings filter page. Verify sidebar navigation works across all pages. Document component structure in README. Create .orchestrator/design-notes.md with design decisions, color tokens, component hierarchy for future reference.
